description: This Java source file defines the ComponentLocationResolver class which implements LocationResolver interface. It is responsible for resolving location strings into URLs, specifically handling component-based locations within the Apache OFBiz framework. The class includes methods for resolving locations and manipulating location strings to include component root paths.

classes.name: ComponentLocationResolver
classes.description: A class that resolves location strings for components into URLs, handling formatting and path adjustments.

methods.name: resolveLocation
methods.description: Resolves a location string into a URL, converting file paths and handling URI syntax.

methods.name: getBaseLocation
methods.description: Static method that extracts and constructs the base location path from a given location string, considering component root locations.
